explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `single_injective`. The other matches are `Finsupp.single_injective`, `HahnSeries.single_injective`, `SkewMonoidAlgebra.single_injective` and similar. Their types are different and none of them is the DFinsupp statement. `DirectSum.of_injective` is stated for `DirectSum.of`, which wraps `DFinsupp.single`. It lives in `Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Basic.lean` and comes after this lemma, so it is not independent evidence. The only other nearby statement is the injectivity of `fun i => single i (b i)`, which is a different result. I found no independent declaration that states `DFinsupp.single_injective`.
